_note: Mints the node the 2026-08-29 tw-browser-unblock round left as a no-node-yet lead: MND's own statistics table 11 (近十年國防部年度預算占中央政府總預算比率統計) names the Central Government General Budget as tw-defense-budget's own statistical universe and states its financial figures are drawn directly from it. tw-dgbas is the compiling institution, not the budget itself, and tw-local-government-finance is sub-national, so neither could take this edge.

reports.title: Central Government General Budget (中央政府總預算)
reports.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS), Executive Yuan
reports.description: Taiwan's annual Central Government General Budget — the national government's consolidated budget proposal and appropriation, compiled by DGBAS. Named by the Ministry of National Defense's own budget-share statistics as the statistical universe its defense-budget-to-total-budget ratio is drawn from.

dependencies.basis: 一、統計範圍及對象：中央政府總預算及國防部主管單位預算資料為統計對象。 1.中央政府總預算金額指中央政府總預算歲出預算數。 (MND statistics table 11, 近十年國防部年度預算占中央政府總預算比率統計)
